elements.text:
class ScholarXState(TypedDict, total=False):
    session_id:             str
    student_profile:        Optional[StudentProfile]
    candidate_scholarships: Annotated[List[Scholarship], merge_lists]
    eligibility_results:    Annotated[Dict[str, Any], merge_dicts]
    cost_results:           Annotated[Dict[str, CostResult], merge_dicts]
    deadline_results:       Annotated[Dict[str, DeadlineResult], merge_dicts]
    evidence_trails:        Annotated[Dict[str, EvidenceTrail], merge_dicts]
    skeptic_challenges:     Annotated[Dict[str, List[Challenge]], merge_dicts]
    ranked_results:         List[CompositeScoreResult]
    final_roadmap:          Optional[ApplicationRoadmap]
    events_queue:           Annotated[List[ScholarXEvent], merge_lists]

elements.text:
State Reducer Principles:
• merge_lists(left, right): Combines candidate pools and event queues from concurrent
  regional scouts without overwriting peer data.
• merge_dicts(left, right): Accumulates stage outputs (eligibility, PKR cost models,
  deadline calculations, skeptic red-team trails) into a unified dictionary indexed by ID.
• Checkpointed State: Enables instantaneous pause/resume, audit replays, and rollback.

Key Benefits of Decoupled Streaming:
• Zero pipeline blocking: LangGraph advances without waiting for frontend rendering.
• Live Command Theatre: Displays active agent thoughts, candidate counters & radar updates.
• Graceful degradation: If SSE client disconnects, graph execution continues unaffected.
